> Shee Aesthetics is a beauty salon in Meru Town, Meru County, Kenya — facials, waxing, massage, and makeup. Book online and confirm with M-Pesa.

## Brand
- Name: Shee Aesthetics
- Founder / artist: Shee
- Area served: Meru Town and Meru County, Kenya
- Site: https://sheeaesthetics.co.ke/

## Services (summary)
- Facials (deep cleansing, brightening, hydrating, express, anti-ageing)
- Waxing (brows, face, underarms, legs, bikini/Brazilian, full body)
- Massage (Swedish, deep tissue, back/neck/shoulders, hot stone)
- Makeup (everyday, soft glam, bridal/event, evening/photography)
- Full packages (facial + wax + massage + makeup) on Tuesdays and Wednesdays
- Single treatments Monday and Thursday–Saturday

## Hours (published booking cadence)
- Full packages: Tuesday and Wednesday
- Single treatments: Monday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
- Confirm live availability on the book flow
